svg.title: The brief's pressure investigation, generated from the same topology and observations as the demo

g.text: Nearby pressure drops overlap in time
Inspect Trunk / P1, 200-600m; not an exact leak point.
Review instrumentation; do not infer a leak location.
Existing detector alerts → Agent-assisted investigation → Human review
Patterns are evidence, not proof: check operating changes and shared failures.
Demo assumptions: 24 pipe-mounted pressure instruments, 12 paired stations, three connected 800m segments.
Same pressure-pack-v3 geometry as console; seed 2026, [80,140)s, pressure in bar; independent trace y-scales; synthetic.
